card.name: The word powder in drug forms
card.fires_on: The word "powder" (or its pieces, such as POW and DER) when it names a dosage form, as in powder for oral solution, injection or inhalation. It also fires, more weakly, on powdered garden compound.

modes.label: Powder as a dosage form
modes.description: "Powder" names a product form such as oral powder or powder for injection or suspension.
